metadata.sourceNotes: 2025 roster snapshot derived from nflverse roster_2025.csv, filtered to individual positions used by the draft game: QB, RB, WR, TE, and K. DST is modeled as a team-level draft slot, so defensive, offensive line, punter, and long snapper player records are intentionally excluded from this local game dataset. Low-confidence unmatched players have been removed; this dataset keeps only high- and medium-confidence rated players. This file is further filtered to high-confidence rated players only.

ratingSources.name: EA Sports Madden NFL 26 ratings
ratingSources.notes: Official Madden NFL 26 Super Bowl ratings, pulled from the structured ratings payload exposed by EA page pagination.

ratingSources.name: FantasyPros 2025 Value-Based Drafting rankings
ratingSources.notes: FantasyPros VBD pages for QB, RB, WR, TE, K, and DST were used as fantasy-value signals.

metadata.ratingNotes: Player overall blends Madden overall with FantasyPros position value when both are available. Madden-only and FantasyPros-only players are retained as medium-confidence records. Low-confidence fallback records are intentionally excluded from this local game dataset. Only high-confidence player ratings are retained in this dataset; medium, low, and fallback player records were removed at the user's request.
